title: Consolidation: From Alfréd Hajós to the Aranycsapat: Sport & National Identity

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can summarize the major milestones of Hungarian sports history from Alfréd Hajós to modern champions.
I can fluently construct consecutive degree clauses using olyannyira / annyira / olyan mértékben ..., hogy...
I can deploy dynamic motion preverbs (kicselez, kivéd, végigküzd, felülkerekedik) in athletic and strategic narratives.
